title: HOA Assessment Shock Scanner
oneLiner: Condo buyers and owners paste HOA docs to spot surprise assessment exposure before the bill lands.
signals: S2 Reddit r/HOA: special assessment risk before buying
S3 Axios San Diego: HOA fees rising with insurance pressure
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "HOA Assessment Shock Scanner" for condo buyers and owners. Build a data-forward due-diligence workbench where users paste HOA budget/reserve/meeting-minute/insurance excerpts and get a shock exposure score, missing coverage checklist, deductible split estimate, red-flag excerpts, and a buyer action queue. Required sections: document intake strip, exposure score, red-flag excerpts, coverage gap checklist, scenario table, action queue, and exportable question sheet. Design direction: use the `financial-analyst` profile with institutional off-white, graphite, muted navy, restrained warning tones, compact comparison tables, and calm confidence cues; make it feel like a premium risk memo rather than a consumer quiz.
